harvestIndicators: Vines fully covering ground at full bloom for cover termination
notes: Vigna unguiculata. Warm-season legume cover. Fixes 80 to 130 lb N per acre. Heat- and drought-tolerant. Terminate at bloom for max N. Inoculate with cowpea-type Rhizobium at sowing. Sold by Hancock Seed, Green Cover Seed, Welter.
